title: Rag and Bone Man
start: Talk to the Odd Old Man at the quarry west of Paterdomus.

items.t: 8 core logs of any type (can be collected during quest, eternal magic logs does not work)
A rope (needed to get into Lumbridge Swamp Cave if you haven't placed a rope there before, unless you have started The Lost Tribe)

recommended.t: Teleport methods to Varrock, and Falador
Explorer's ring 3 or 4 for quick access to Draynor Village (Cabbage-port)
Invitation box for quick access to the Odd Old Man
If not owned, use the Fort Forinthry lodestone or the earth altar teleport.
Yanille lodestone activated if not Spirit tree (in order to go to Yanille)
1 law rune and 1 air rune for Telekinetic Grab if killing a monkey in Ardougne Zoo.

kills.t: You will need to kill a variety of monsters to obtain their bones (most common level 2 to 23).

steps.t: Talk to the Odd Old Man in Silvarea. [Chat: 1 Anything I can do to help? › Accept]

Go to Draynor Village market and talk to Fortunato about the quest (do not steal from the stalls before talking to him, as you won't be able to initiate the conversation for a couple of minutes). [Chat: 2 Talk about Rag and Bone Man.]
Use the jugs of vinegar on your empty pots.
Gather and use each bone listed below on the pots of vinegar.
Obtain the bones. Use the table below as a reference.
Go back to the Odd Old Man's hut.
Add logs, then a pot of bones to the pot boiler, and light it. Collect the bone when it finishes boiling after 12 seconds (hopping worlds will skip the boiling).
Talk to the Odd Old Man.
